actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modality identity evidence (RNA pathway shifts, PBRM1-low/ATM-wildtype mutation pattern, 3p/14q CNV features) and cross-modal membership support with a directionally consistent boundary to C0002. Site/kernel associations are present but below the warning threshold and do not obviously explain the molecular signal; residual site confounding is a limitation but not decision-critical for retaining this discovery-stage candidate.

C0002 shows a coherent, complementary multi-modality identity (mirror-image RNA pathways, PBRM1-high/ATM-mutant pattern, 3p/14q CNV features) with cross-modal membership support and a consistent boundary to C0001. Site/kernel associations remain a limitation but do not plausibly explain the defining molecular signal, so the candidate is defensible for downstream validation.
